sn1.60:1.1: Kiṃsu nidānaṃ gāthānaṃ || kiṃsu tāsaṃ viyañjanaṃ || kiṃsu sannissitā gāthā || kiṃsu gāthānam āsayo ti || ||
sn1.60:2.1: Chando nidānaṃ gāthānaṃ || akkharā tāsaṃ viyañjanaṃ || nāmasannissitā gāthā || kavi gāthānam āsayo ti || || Jarā-vaggo chaṭṭho ||
sn1.60:3.0: Tass-uddānam || || Jarā Ajarasā Mittaṃ || Vatthu tīṇi Janāni ca || Uppatho ca Dutiyo ca || Kavinā purito vaggo ti || || ___________________________________________
